rationale: No country variable in the dictionary; the ISO3 code 'CHL' is a constant assigned during harmonization, not a raw variable.
Interview year can be extracted from fecha_entrev (AAAAMMDD); the survey year is also known from the survey itself (CASEN 2020).
Month of interview is obtained from the MM part of fecha_entrev (AAAAMMDD).
region holds the first-level administrative region code.
zona is coded 1=Urbano, 2=Rural; recode rural to 0 and urban to 1 (area has an extra RAU category, so zona is preferred).
folio uniquely identifies the household (comuna, area, segment, dwelling, household).
o is the person order number within the household; id_persona is an alternative identifier.
expr is the regional expansion factor, the standard CASEN weight; expp and expc are provincial and communal alternatives.
The same regional expansion factor expr applies at person level in CASEN.
cod_upm is the primary sampling unit; varunit is the variance cluster alternative.
The 'estrato' variable (comuna, zona) is the sampling stratum; 'varstrat' is a variance stratum and is an alternative.
pco1 gives the relationship to the household head and can be recoded into head, spouse, child, other relative and non-relative; the listing is truncated and may not show codes for domestic worker.
sexo uses the same coding, 1=male and 2=female.
edad is the person's age in years.
ecivil can be recoded: 8 to single, 1/2/3 to union, 4/5/6 to divorced or separated, 7 to widowed.
r3 and the derived etnia identify indigenous peoples, while no afro-descendant category is collected, so the rest map to other.
No disability or functional limitation questions appear in the dictionary.
inmigrante flags persons not born in Chile, which proxies international migrant status.
activ gives employed/unemployed/inactive, and edad is needed to assign below working age to those under the minimum age.
o15 gives the employment category in the main job: 1 employer, 2 own account, 3-5 and 6-7 employee (domestic service included), 9 unpaid, 8 armed forces as other.
Main-job occupation is given by CIUO-08 1-digit/4-digit codes (oficio1_08, oficio4_08), which can be recoded to the 9 IDB groups, restricted to the employed (activ).
Industry of main job is in CIIU Rev.4 (rama1/rama4) and must be regrouped to IDB's industry categories for the employed.
The dictionary only has agreed monthly days/hours with the employer (y2_dias, y2_hrs), not usual or actual weekly hours worked, so weekly hours cannot be built reliably.
There is no hours-worked variable for all jobs; only agreed monthly hours in the main job are present.
No question on the number of workers in the firm appears in the dictionary (only SII registration and accounting type).
o15 categories 3 (public sector employee) and 4 (public enterprise employee), and possibly 8 (armed forces), identify public-sector workers.
The survey has no question on written contract or contract type/duration in the main job.
o32 asks whether the person contributed to a pension system last month (codes 1-5 yes, 6 no), applicable to the employed.
o31 directly asks whether the person is affiliated to a pension system (1=yes, 2=no).

Monetary income of the main job is the sum of salary, extras and bonuses for employees (y0101..y0404) or independent cash income (y0701), with corrected versions y0101c/y0701c or the aggregate yoprcor as alternatives.
Non-monetary income in main job comes from in-kind payments to employees (y0501-y0512) plus in-kind withdrawals by the self-employed (y0801).
Secondary occupation income for employees (yosa) and self-employed (yosi) gives monetary income from the second job.
Total monetary labor income sums main-job wages, additional monetary payments, self-employed cash income and secondary job income (alternatively corrected series y0101c, y0701c).
Total non-monetary labor income is the sum of in-kind income components from employee and self-employed work.
Monetary non-labor income aggregates rents, transfers, remittances, interest, subsidies and pensions; the composition requires judgment on what to include.
Contributory pensions include old-age and disability pensions (with and without APS), survivor and orphan pensions, excluding the non-contributory basic solidarity pensions.
Money from relatives outside the household, from within the country (yfa1) and abroad (yfa2), is the closest match to remittances; the target may be limited to yfa2.
yaimh is the household imputed rent (alquiler imputado) variable.
lp is the official poverty line given in the survey.
li is the official indigence (extreme poverty) line given in the survey.
asiste2 is the derived attendance indicator (1=Asiste, 2=No asiste), which can be recoded to 0/1; e2 is the underlying question.
esc2 (untruncated years of schooling, age>=15) and esc give years of education directly; e6a/e6b could be used to build it for those under 15.
The dictionary has no question on whether the education institution attended is public or private.
v20=1 (red pública) gives piped network water, refined by v20_red and v22 for access within the dwelling or site.
v20 records the origin of the dwelling's water (public network, well, river, tanker truck, other), which maps to main water source.
No variable on electricity or lighting source appears in the dictionary.
v23 indicates whether an excreta system exists, and v23_sistema and v23_cajon give the type of sanitation facility.
The dictionary has no variable on floor material.
The dictionary has no variable on wall material.
The dictionary has no variable on roof material.

v29 gives the number of exclusive-sleeping bedrooms used by the household (v27 is the dwelling total and is relevant when v28 shows the household is the main one), so it matches the household-level dormitorios variable.
The dictionary only records bedrooms used exclusively for sleeping (v27, v29) and has no question on the total number of rooms in the dwelling.

v13 gives the tenure situation (1 owned, 2 rented, 3 ceded, 9-11 usufruct/irregular occupation), which can be recoded to rented/owned/occupied de facto, with the sub-questions refining the categories.
No variable in the dictionary asks about household internet access.
The dictionary has no question on household mobile phone service; the tel1-tel8 variables are only contact-attempt paradata.
No household asset question on computer ownership appears in the dictionary.
No household asset question on refrigerator ownership appears in the dictionary.
There is no question on car ownership; y0504 and y5d only capture a private vehicle provided as an employer in-kind benefit.
